authority: User decisions; CW and AIGMos evolve concurrently, not final LOCKED

confirmed.off: No continuous normal successful CS logging; still mandatory on CS errors, so logging cannot be totally disabled.
confirmed.cs: Log all CS executions and parameters. Dependency: CS only.
confirmed.ac: Log all CS executions/parameters and actor identity. Dependencies: CS and AccessCore.
confirmed.conditional_dependency: Select optional logging deps per chosen mode; do not remove mandatory Error mechanism or error-triggered CS log.
confirmed.buffer: Independent Log Buffer count in config.json; N>=1 retains newest N, 0 retains all.
confirmed.error_actor: When AC runtime-active, Errors always include actor even in off/cs mode.
confirmed.dedupe: CS error creates no extra CS record if already captured by regular mode.

mode_matrix.fail: one CS + actor log + Error Buffer

not_agreed: Concrete config.json names or default capacities
Standalone Audit subsystem; bot-training Audit excluded, Q/runtime parity still required
Mode ac when AC included but runtime-disabled
open: Exact config.json field names/default counts; 0=all RAM consequences.
Buffer ownership/location and access, read/clear and FILE export.
Build-mode/runtime switch policy, AC runtime-disabled behavior.
Secret-safe complete CS parameter capture; correlation/dedupe across nested invocations.

cs/ac success captured; failure not duplicated.
